description: This file defines the ApcuBackend class which implements cache storage using APCu for Drupal, including methods for fetching, storing, invalidating, and managing cache items with site-specific key prefixes.

classes.name: ApcuBackend
classes.description: Implements cache backend using APCu with site-specific key management and cache invalidation features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ApcuBackend with cache bin name, site prefix, checksum provider, and time service.

methods.name: getApcuKey
methods.description: Generates the APCu key by prefixing cache item ID with bin and site prefixes.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cache item by ID, preparing it for validity.

methods.name: getMultiple
methods.description: Fetches multiple cache items by their IDs, with optional preload of cache tags.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all cache items with the current bin prefix.

methods.name: prepareItem
methods.description: Validates and prepares a cache item, checking expiration and tags validity.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a cache item with specified data, expiration, and tags.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Stores multiple cache items at once.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a cache item by ID.

methods.name: deleteMultiple
methods.description: Deletes multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all cache items in the current bin.

methods.name: removeBin
methods.description: Removes all cache items in the current bin.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Invalidates a cache item by ID.

methods.name: invalidateMultiple
methods.description: Invalidates multiple cache items by their IDs.

methods.name: invalidateAll
methods.description: Invalidates all cache items in the current bin, deprecated in favor of deleteAll.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Creates an APCUIterator for cache key matching.
